verdictRationale: Every committed dataset/media item resolves to a registry record with source, license, reviewed rights profile, split, and dedup lineage (38/38; 35 by path, 3 bench-bundle clips byte-identical to corpus recordings). Unknown rights are quarantined by construction everywhere audited (26 quarantined registry entries across pickleball + ood; rightsForLicense returns all-unclear for unrecognized licenses; trainingEligible() requires affirmative train+store+analyze). Training permission is never inferred from analysis permission on any traced code path. The single P1 gap found (pickle-real per-event 'training-ready' records carried no eligibility flag, so locked-test/held-out events were exportable as training input) is fixed in the release generator with regression tests; the three already-released manifests are immutable by policy and are marked unresolved-by-policy with the mitigation that all downstream training consumers audited (distill_export.py) already quarantine held-out roles independently.
method: Enumerated all committed media via git ls-files (38 files) and reconciled each against corpus recordings.json, paddle-bench registry/paddle-bench.json, ood registry, and pickleball registry, with SHA-256 content-hash fallback (script: datasets/experiments/wave-h/h20_provenance_audit.py; output: h20-provenance-manifest.json).

Audited all 20 corpus sources for complete six-modality rights profiles (store/analyze/annotate/train/redistributeDerivatives/commercial) and all 26 recordings for source resolution, split assignment, and derivedFrom lineage.

Traced every training-selection code path: services/media-worker/src/trainingConsent.ts (SQL restricted to scope='model_training', latest ledger action, capture-mode coverage, fresh-connection revalidation), tools/paddle-lab/distill_export.py (rights gate + explicit model_training consent gate for first-party, held-out roles hard-quarantined), packages/first-party-intake/src/consentRef.ts (requires BOTH video_analysis AND model_training active; absence = not consented), services/api consent/privacy routes (privacy-center mirrors only revocations into the ledger, never grants), packages/swing-lab engine/rights.ts + datasetRelease.ts.

Verified paddle-distill-v0.1 release: 417 examples, 382 training-eligible (all development split, zero with sourceUserId), 35 quarantined (28 held_out + 7 test_held_out), 0 held-out examples marked eligible, all eligible rights train in {yes, yes_with_attribution}.
Verified held-out cases wm-dink-01 and afn-vic-rally1 carry held_out/test_held_out roles and were not modified.
Ran root gates on the branch: pnpm typecheck, pnpm test (599 passed | 4 skipped), pnpm lint, pnpm format:check — all pass. Mobile untouched.

P1.finding: pickle-real release manifests emit per-event 'training-ready' records for ALL target-owner events including held_out (wm-dink-01) and test_held_out (afn-vic-rally1) splits, with no trainingEligible flag or quarantine reasons — a downstream consumer reading manifest.events as training input could train on locked test / holdout footage.
P1.fix: packages/swing-lab/src/trainingGate.ts: default-quarantine per-event gate (only development split + rights-cleared source may be eligible; unknown rights quarantined); wired into datasetRelease.ts so every future release event carries explicit trainingEligible + quarantineReasons, plus a hard problem if a non-development event is ever marked eligible. Regression tests: packages/swing-lab/test/trainingGate.test.ts (6 tests).
P1.residual: Released manifests v0.1–v0.3 are immutable by policy and still lack the flag (unresolved-by-policy). Mitigation: the only audited training exporter (tools/paddle-lab/distill_export.py) independently quarantines held-out roles, and its shipped release has 0 held-out eligible examples.

P2.finding: 3 bench-bundle clips (afn-sasebo-rally1, wm-dink-01, wm-volley-02 under datasets/paddle-bench/bundles/*/clip.mp4) have no path-level registry entry; each is byte-identical (SHA-256 verified) to a registered corpus recording, so provenance is resolvable by content hash only.

Session wm-tournament-2014 spans development and held_out splits (known limitation already recorded in splits.json and release warnings; different players from one recording; acceptable only while corpus is tiny).
